title: Understanding Clustering
text: Clustering is a method of grouping a set of objects in such a way that objects in the same group (called a cluster) are more similar to each other than to those in other groups.

title: Silhouette Score
text: The silhouette score is a measure of how similar an object is to its own cluster compared to other clusters. It ranges from $$-1$$ to $$1$$, where a high value indicates that the object is well matched to its own cluster and poorly matched to neighboring clusters.

title: K-Means Clustering
text: K-Means is a popular clustering algorithm that partitions data into K clusters, where each data point belongs to the cluster with the nearest mean.
